title: Founding Zomato as a restaurant-listing pivot
statement: Goyal and Pankaj Chaddah built Zomato from an internal office cafeteria menu wiki into the subcontinent's dominant restaurant discovery platform.
outcome: The pivot to food delivery in 2015 rode the smartphone boom; Zomato's 2021 IPO was the landmark listing of the Indian startup era.

title: Blinkit acquisition — the 10-minute grocery gamble
statement: Zomato acquired loss-making quick-commerce pioneer Blinkit for roughly $568 million in stock, betting that 10-minute grocery would consolidate faster than food delivery and at greater scale.
outcome: The deal was initially punished by investors; within two years Blinkit became the growth narrative that re-rated Zomato's entire equity story, with quick-commerce valuations exceeding the food-delivery core.
